verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client with team vaults and cloud sync, so a public API with an interactive reference is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the pack contains no evidence of an API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file only indexes product documentation, which is not an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
